def markers_at(xc):
    # vertical profile in 7px window
    win=black[:, xc-3:xc+4].sum(1)
    # candidate rows: win>=2
    rows=[y for y in range(24,228) if win[y]>=2]
    # group into bands (gap<=2)
    bands=[]
    for y in rows:
        if bands and y-bands[-1][-1]<=2: bands[-1].append(y)
        else: bands.append([y])
    out=[]
    for b in bands:
        span=max(b)-min(b)+1
        if span<4:  # too thin = line or noise
            continue
        # exclude legend box (x<226 & y<150)
        if xc<226 and max(b)<150:
            continue
        # within a band, find marker centers = local maxima of win
        # smooth
        ys=np.array(b)
        wv=win[ys]
        # split into sub-bands at valleys
        # find peaks: a peak is a local max with span
        # simple: if band span>8, there may be 2 markers -> find 2 peaks
        if span>9:
            # find two strongest peaks separated
            order=np.argsort(wv)[::-1]
            peaks=[]
            for i in order:
                if all(abs(ys[i]-p)>4 for p in peaks): peaks.append(ys[i])
                if len(peaks)>=3: break
            for p in sorted(peaks):
                out.append((p, float(win[p])))
        else:
            # single marker: center = row of max win
            p=int(ys[np.argmax(wv)])
            # refine: use centroid weighted by win over band
            yc=np.average(ys, weights=win[ys])
            out.append((int(round(yc)), float(win[int(yc)])))
    # dedupe close
    out=sorted(out)
    dd=[]
    for (y,k) in out:
        if dd and y-dd[-1][0]<5: 
            if k>dd[-1][1]: dd[-1]=(y,k)
            continue
        dd.append((y,k))
    return dd

    for p in pts:
        if any(abs(p[0]-q[0])<=4 and abs(p[1]-q[1])<=4 for q in kept): continue
        kept.append(p)

print('BLUE n=',len(blue_pts))

# ---- filled black markers: erode to kill lines ----

filled=[]
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs = np.where(lab==i)
    if len(xs)<3: continue
    cx,cy = xs.mean(), ys.mean()
    filled.append((cx,cy,len(xs)))
filled.sort()
for cx,cy,s in filled: print(f'  ({cx:.1f},{cy:.1f}) size={s}')

# ---- open markers: small enclosed white holes ----
wl,nw = ndimage.label(white)
# background = component touching border
bg = set(wl[0,:]) | set(wl[-1,:]) | set(wl[:,0]) | set(wl[:,-1])
holes=[]
for i in range(1,nw+1):
    if i in bg: continue
    ys,xs = np.where(wl==i)
    area=len(xs)
    if area<2 or area>60: continue
    cx,cy = xs.mean(), ys.mean()
    if not (76<cx<350 and 18<cy<228): continue
    if cx<206 and cy<136: continue
    holes.append((cx,cy,area))
holes.sort()
print('HOLE candidates n=',len(holes))
for cx,cy,s in holes: print(f'  ({cx:.1f},{cy:.1f}) area={s}')

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage

im = np.array(Image.open('images/fig_093.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[:,:,0], im[:,:,1], im[:,:,2]
red  = (R>140)&(G<110)&(B<110)
blue = (B>120)&(R<110)
black= (R<110)&(G<110)&(B<110)
H,W = black.shape

grid = [101,115,129,143,157,171,185,200,214,228,242,256,270,284,299,313,327]
# in_legend: exclude x<200,y<125 (legend markers/text), but check overlap
def in_legend(x,y): return x<200 and y<125

# For each column: collect black clusters in strip x0±6
for x0 in grid:
    xlo,xhi = x0-6, x0+7
    strip = black[14:229, xlo:xhi]
    # remove legend
    sl = np.zeros_like(strip); 
    for yy in range(strip.shape[0]):
        if in_legend(xlo+np.arange(strip.shape[1]).mean(), yy+14):
            sl[yy,:] = False
    ys = np.where(strip.any(axis=1))[0]
    groups=[]
    if len(ys):
        cur=[ys[0]]
        for v in ys[1:]:
            if v-cur[-1] <= 2: cur.append(v)
            else: groups.append(cur); cur=[v]
        groups.append(cur)
    line=[]
    for g in groups:
        y0,y1 = g[0]+14, g[-1]+14
        sub = black[y0:y1+1, xlo:xhi]
        n = int(sub.sum())
        if n < 5: continue
        # hole check within this cluster: fill holes
        filled = ndimage.binary_fill_holes(sub)
        hole = int(filled.sum()-sub.sum())
        h_ = y1-y0+1; w_ = xhi-xlo
        yy,xx = np.where(sub)
        cy = yy.mean()+y0
        cx = xx.mean()+xlo
        # local tight bbox
        hh = yy.max()-yy.min()+1; ww = xx.max()-xx.min()+1
        fill = n/(hh*ww)
        line.append(f'y={cy:.1f} n={n} bbox={ww}x{hh} hole={hole} fill={fill:.2f}')
    print(f'col x={x0}: ' + ' | '.join(line))

def detect(color, thresh=0.5, ksize=5, minsize=4):
    mask = np.zeros_like(color)
    mask[21:230, 73:355] = color[21:230, 73:355]
    mask[22:125, 74:212] = False  # legend
    dens = ndimage.uniform_filter(mask.astype(float), size=ksize)
    blob = dens > thresh
    lab,n = ndimage.label(blob)
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
        s=len(xs)
        if s<minsize: continue
        # centroid weighted by the actual color pixels within this blob
        wy=color[ys,xs]
        out.append((xs.mean(), ys.mean(), s))
    out.sort()
    return out
